def.zh-tw: 放在標準位置（頂點在原點、始邊在 $x$ 軸正向）的有向角：逆時針旋轉為正、順時針旋轉為負，可以小於 $0^\circ$ 或大於 $180^\circ$。
def.en: A directed angle in standard position (vertex at the origin, initial side on the positive $x$-axis): counterclockwise turns are positive and clockwise turns negative, so it can be below $0^\circ$ or above $180^\circ$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：廣義角 generalized angle

def.zh-tw: 角的始邊旋轉後停下來的那一邊；放在標準位置時，終邊所在的象限就是這個角所在的象限。
def.en: The side where an angle's initial side stops after turning; in standard position, the quadrant of the terminal side is the quadrant of the angle.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：終邊 terminal side

def.zh-tw: 用 $[r,\theta]$ 表示平面上的點 $P$：$r$ 是 $P$ 到極點（原點）的距離，$\theta$ 是以極軸（$x$ 軸正向）為始邊、終邊通過 $P$ 的廣義角。
def.en: Writing a point $P$ of the plane as $[r,\theta]$: $r$ is the distance from $P$ to the pole (the origin), and $\theta$ is a generalised angle with the polar axis (the positive $x$-axis) as initial side and its terminal side through $P$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：極坐標 polar coordinates
